rows.q: What data do you have access to?
rows.answer:
Great question! Right now I'm sitting on top of the whole MDS community — 720 active members, 18 WhatsApp chats, 20 chapters and 33 upcoming events. Here's what I can actually tap into:

• *WhatsApp chats* — daily digests and message history across the groups. Try: "what were people saying about freight forwarders this week?"

• *The Facebook group* — posts and comments, plus full threads. Try: "what's the latest discussion on Q4 strategy?"

• *Member profiles* — public info like niche, expertise, city, fun facts. Try: "who should I talk to about TikTok Shop?"

• *Events* — upcoming and past, plus who's attending. Try: "any dinners coming up near me?"

• *Partner deals* — vetted discounts and service providers. Try: "any deals on bookkeeping or 3PLs?"

• *Video library* — Mogul Calls, Expert Calls and webinars by topic or speaker. Try: "any recordings about AI automation?"

• *Your own stuff* — your profile, chats, event registrations, even what you wrote on your application.

One honest limit: I can't search _inside_ call recordings yet — I know what a call was about and who ran it, but not what was said minute to minute. That one's coming.

Want to try one out?
